title: GFW drivers of deforestation alerts — AI-assigned causes across tropics
snippet: Global Forest Watch introduces AI-assigned deforestation driver classification for tropical forest loss alerts. The system automatically categorizes detected vegetation disturbances by probable cause — commodity-driven deforestation, shifting agriculture, forestry, wildfire, and urbanization — using machine learning trained on satellite imagery and ground truth data. Provides actionable intelligence for enforcement and policy across tropical regions in Southeast Asia, Amazon basin, and Central Africa.
tag_reason: New AI-driven deforestation cause classification system. Complements src-018 DIST-ALERT with driver attribution capability.
